title: S04 — Benefits diagram
body:
# S04 — Benefits diagram

## Goals and outcomes

One declaration per action; no transport drift; every invocation audited.

## Measures

The registry count (549), the served operations (580) and the lock check (green at a9a5f20a).

## Benefits and sub-benefits

Serves B4 (outside contribution: one declaration is the contribution surface) and B6 (the
coverage the registry gives); the sub-benefits are the six gate clauses.
